focusRules: .nav-menu > summary:hover .nav-menu__indicator, .nav-menu > summary:focus-visible .nav-menu__indicator { background: color-mix(in srgb, currentcolor 12%, transparent); opacity: 1; }
.hero-locations a:hover, .hero-locations a:focus-visible { border-color: var(--mint-deep); background: var(--paper-mint); }
.property-nav > div a:hover, .property-nav > div a:focus-visible { background: var(--paper-mint); }

violations.description: Ensure the contrast between foreground and background colors meets WCAG 2 AA minimum contrast ratio thresholds
violations.help: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds

nodes.failureSummary:
Fix any of the following:
  Element has insufficient color contrast of 3.47 (foreground color: #ffffff, background color: #838b8c, font size: 9.8pt (13.12px), font weight: bold). Expected contrast ratio of 4.5:1
